lines.text: In Lagos, a phone importer sends a thirty percent deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.
lines.say: In Lagos, a phone importer sends a thirty percent deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.

lines.text: The other seventy percent is still to come. That balance is where it goes wrong.
lines.say: The other seventy percent is still to come. That balance is where it goes wrong.

lines.text: Goods that never arrive. Payments redirected by a fake "our bank details have changed" message.
lines.say: Goods that never arrive. Payments redirected by a fake message: our bank details have changed.

lines.text: A naira that can lose a third of its value between the deposit and the balance.
lines.say: A Nyra that can lose a third of its value, between the deposit and the balance.

lines.text: And letters of credit have almost vanished, so most of this trade moves by plain bank transfer.
lines.say: And letters of credit have almost vanished, so most of this trade moves by plain bank transfer.

lines.text: Arra fixes that. Arra is Latin for earnest money: the deposit that secures a deal.
lines.say: Ahra fixes that. Ahra is Latin for earnest money: the deposit that secures a deal.

lines.text: Pay the deposit, and keep the balance locked until it ships, in an open contract on Celo: not with Arra, not with the supplier.
lines.say: Pay the deposit, and keep the balance locked until it ships, in an open contract on Sello: not with Ahra, not with the supplier.

lines.text: Start by describing the order, like a message. Arra's assistant turns it into clear terms.
lines.say: Start by describing the order, like a message. Ahra's assistant turns it into clear terms.

lines.text: Words nobody can check, like "good quality", are refused, and the terms are fingerprinted so they can't change later.
lines.say: Words nobody can check, like good quality, are refused. And the terms are fingerprinted, so they can't change later.

lines.text: Then send your supplier one link. They read the exact terms, in English or Chinese, connect the wallet they want to be paid in, and agree.
lines.say: Then, send your supplier one link. They read the exact terms, in English or Chinese, connect the wallet they want to be paid in, and agree.

lines.text: No account numbers copied from a chat, so a scammer's look-alike address can't slip in.
lines.say: No account numbers copied from a chat. So a scammer's look-alike address can't slip in.

lines.text: Pay in dollars, or straight from naira, even inside MiniPay.
lines.say: Pay in dollars, or straight from Nyra. Even inside Mini Pay.

lines.text: The supplier accepts and gets the deposit instantly. The balance waits until the goods ship.
lines.say: The supplier accepts and gets the deposit instantly. The balance waits until the goods ship.

lines.text: Every naira payment is a Textile FX fill: a firm quote for exactly the dollars the order needs, settled in one transaction.
lines.say: Every Nyra payment is a Textile F X fill: a firm quote for exactly the dollars the order needs, settled in one transaction.

lines.text: Our first one on mainnet turned naira, at about thirteen hundred and seventy-four to the dollar, straight into a locked order.
lines.say: Our first one on main net turned Nyra, at about thirteen hundred and seventy four to the dollar, straight into a locked order.

lines.text: That one rate matters. In 2023, an importer with a seven-thousand-dollar balance needed two million naira more, just seven weeks later.
lines.say: That one rate matters. In twenty twenty-three, an importer with a seven thousand dollar balance needed two million Nyra more, just seven weeks later.

lines.text: With Arra, that balance was paid for on day one.
lines.say: With Ahra, that balance was paid for on day one.

lines.text: When the goods arrive, check them. Everything's right? Pay the balance with one tap, all at once or in parts.
lines.say: When the goods arrive, check them. Everything's right? Pay the balance with one tap. All at once, or in parts.

lines.text: Something wrong? Report it with a photo. The supplier accepts, or makes an offer.
lines.say: Something wrong? Report it with a photo. The supplier accepts, or makes an offer.

lines.text: Changed your mind before they accept? Cancel and get everything back. If they never accept, or never ship, Arra's agent refunds you automatically.
lines.say: Changed your mind before they accept? Cancel, and get everything back. If they never accept, or never ship, Ahra's agent refunds you automatically.

lines.text: Silence can't freeze the money, and nobody, not even Arra, can send it anywhere but to the buyer or the supplier.
lines.say: Silence can't freeze the money, and nobody, not even Ahra, can send it anywhere but to the buyer or the supplier.

lines.text: The same contract works for any deal with a deposit and a balance: a house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.
lines.say: The same contract works for any deal with a deposit and a balance: a house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.

lines.text: Arra is live on Celo mainnet. A friend's real order ran start to finish: locked, accepted with the deposit, balance paid.
lines.say: Ahra is live on Sello main net. A friend's real order ran start to finish: locked, accepted with the deposit, balance paid.

lines.text: With a verified contract, a registered agent, and naira orders filled through Textile.
lines.say: With a verified contract, a registered agent, and Nyra orders filled through Textile.

lines.text: Arra. Trade with anyone, without the worry.
lines.say: Ahra. Trade with anyone, without the worry.
